questions.question: What post-tax NPV and IRR did European Metals' December 2025 definitive feasibility study give for the Cinovec lithium project, and what lithium carbonate price was it based on?

facts: Post-tax NPV (8% discount rate, real) of about US$802 million excluding grant funding, with a post-tax IRR of 11.2%
Including grant funding the post-tax NPV8 is about US$1,135 million and the IRR 13.2%
Based on a lithium carbonate price of US$26,000 per tonne
truth.tolerance: rounding of NPV to the nearest US$10 million is fine; either the ex-grant or incl.-grant case counts for the first fact only if the answer says which case it is
truth.source: EMH RNS 3250M 19 Dec 2025, DFS summary Table 2.1 p7

questions.question: How much up-front capital does the Cinovec lithium project in Czechia need according to its latest feasibility study, and how big is its ore reserve?

facts: Initial capex of about US$2.16 billion (US$2,164.9 million, real)
Proved and Probable Ore Reserves of 54.4 Mt (about 0.27% Li)
Study is the definitive feasibility study released 19 December 2025
truth.source: EMH RNS 3250M 19 Dec 2025, DFS summary Table 2.1 p7

questions.question: Does Savannah's Barroso lithium project in Portugal have a declared ore reserve? If so, how large and at what grade?

facts: Yes: a maiden JORC Probable Ore Reserve declared with the Phase 1 DFS in July 2026
20.0 Mt at 0.99% Li2O
The reserve used a conservative spodumene (SC6) price assumption of US$1,200/t

questions.question: What are the headline economics of the Barroso lithium project DFS: NPV, IRR, payback and mine life?

facts: Unlevered post-tax NPV8 of US$913 million
Post-tax IRR of 43% (the release also says 42% in one place)
Post-tax payback of 1.9 years
Initial 14-year life producing about 183,000 tpa of 5.5% Li2O spodumene concentrate

questions.question: What did Mkango's March 2026 updated feasibility study say about the cost and returns of the Songwe Hill rare earths project in Malawi?

facts: Initial capex of about US$325.5 million including a US$27.8 million contingency
Post-tax NPV of about US$339 million at a 10% nominal discount rate
IRR of 24% with a payback of 3.4 years from start of full production
18-year operating life

questions.question: How big is the ore reserve at Songwe Hill and what grade is it?

facts: Proven and Probable Mineral Reserve of about 18.1 Mt grading 1.16% TREO
Proven about 8.16 Mt at 1.28% TREO and Probable about 9.99 Mt at 1.07% TREO
Reserve supported by the 2026 updated DFS (announced 19 March 2026)
truth.tolerance: split by class optional for full credit on fact 1

questions.question: What is the current JORC ore reserve at the Hemerdon tungsten-tin mine in Devon, and who signed it off?

facts: Ore Reserve of 70.7 Mt at 0.15% WO3 and 0.03% Sn
About 10.3 million mtu of contained WO3
Competent Person Alan Turner of AMC Consultants
truth.source: Tungsten West RNS 30 May 2025; AMC FS summary Aug 2025

questions.question: What returns and costs does Tungsten West's 2025 restart plan for Hemerdon show, and what tungsten price did it assume?

facts: Post-tax NPV at 7.5% of US$190 million
IRR of 29.3%
Restart capital of about US$93 million
Base tungsten price of US$400/mtu and target AISC of about US$144/t

questions.question: According to Sibanye-Stillwater's latest technical report summary for the Keliber lithium project, what are its NPV, IRR and capex?

facts: NPV of EUR 411.67 million (8% discount rate)
IRR of 16.87% and payback of 5.4 years
Total capex of EUR 651 million
Report is the S-K 1300 TRS effective 31 December 2024, issued 25 April 2025

questions.question: How large are the lithium ore reserves at Keliber in Finland?

facts: Syvajarvi plus Rapasaari Proven and Probable Mineral Reserves of 12.96 Mt at 0.97% Li2O on a 100% basis, about 311 kt LCE
On Sibanye-Stillwater's 79.82% attributable basis: 10.35 Mt, about 248 kt LCE
Effective 31 December 2024
truth.tolerance: either basis counts for fact 1 if the basis is stated

questions.question: What were the post-tax NPV and IRR in the most recent feasibility study for the Dumont nickel project in Quebec?

facts: Post-tax NPV8% of US$920 million (C$1,226 million)
Post-tax IRR of 15.4%
From the July 2019 NI 43-101 updated feasibility study (RNC Minerals / Ausenco)
Plant starts at 52.5 ktpd with a later expansion to double capacity

questions.question: How big is the Dumont nickel deposit's measured and indicated resource and at what cut-off?

facts: Measured + Indicated 1,665.6 Mt at 0.27% Ni (about 4.43 Mt contained nickel)
Reported at a 0.15% Ni cut-off
Inferred a further 499.8 Mt at 0.26% Ni

questions.question: What is Talga's graphite resource at Vittangi in Sweden, broken down by Indicated and Inferred?

facts: Total 70.8 Mt at 18.8% Cg containing about 13.3 Mt of graphite
Indicated 30.1 Mt at 22.4% Cg
Inferred 40.7 Mt (at about 16.2% Cg)
From the October 2023 resource update

questions.question: What is the JORC resource at GreenRoc's Amitsoq graphite project in Greenland, and has it been updated recently?

facts: 23.05 Mt at 20.41% graphitic carbon, about 4.71 Mt contained graphite (Measured, Indicated and Inferred combined)
Estimate dated January 2023, Competent Person Dr John Arthur
As of October 2026 it is still the current estimate; an update is pending Phase III drilling assays
